summary: Frontend-only regression test after the code-quality refactor (SW extraction, home page split into 6 components, TS strictening, key stability). ALL 8 SPEC BULLETS PASS. (1) Home '/' logged-out renders every section: Navbar visible, hero 'SEASON 1' chip present, H1 exactly 'COLLECT.\nPLAY.\nTRADE.', tagline+description, Explore Cards + Play Now buttons visible, stats 12K/45K/3.2K/50 visible, PYRAX/LUMORA/NOXEL tier chips present, Featured Cards + Why Gachard + How It Works + CTA (Open First Pack + Explore Market) + Footer all visible. (2) Logged-out CTA routing: clicking 'Explore Cards' -> /login (verified), clicking 'Open First Pack' -> /login (verified). (3) Middleware guard via page.request.fetch(max_redirects=0): /koleksi=307->/login?next=%2Fkoleksi, /profil=307->/login?next=%2Fprofil, /topup=307->/login?next=%2Ftopup. (4) With cookie gachard_uid=demo123 + localStorage.user, /koleksi renders 'MY COLLECTION' + 6 rarity/tab testids; /profil renders 'PROFILE' + profile testids; /topup renders 'TOP UP CREDIT' + 5 preset testids (screenshot shows 4 preset cards + POPULAR badge). (5) /marketplace + /scan + /login public shells all return 200. (6) SECURITY — curl http://localhost:3000 | grep -c 'serviceWorker.register' returns 0. layout.tsx has NO dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Registration lives in components/ServiceWorkerRegister.tsx, gated by process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'. (7) /api/mint button behavior: 'Open First Pack' when logged in shows 'OPENING...' state after click (visible in screenshot). (8) No page-level JS errors across all 7 pages navigated.
